descriptionHtml:
About the company

At the company we are a leading provider of nearshore staff augmentation services headquartered in New York. For over two decades, we’ve been delivering top-tier technology solutions to companies of all sizes, from innovative startups to industry leaders, helping them achieve their digital transformation goals.

Our team of 600+ highly skilled tech professionals, based in Latin America, drives digital disruption by partnering with U.S. companies on their most impactful projects. Whether collaborating with Fortune 500 giants or scaling startups, we deliver results that make a difference.

By applying for this position, you’re taking the first step in joining a dynamic team that values your expertise and aspirations. We aim to align your skills with opportunities that foster exceptional career growth and success while contributing to transformative projects that shape the future.

Our Client

Our client is a global technology and creative network built around a unique balance of creative professionals and engineers. Their multidisciplinary approach brings together marketing, technology, and business leaders to drive meaningful results.

They partner with organizations to redefine what is possible, create lasting impact, and drive long-term growth. With a global footprint, they combine creative, technology, and engineering capabilities to support the entire customer-facing journey, from strategy and experience through to the technology that powers it.

Their integrated approach enables them to support leading organizations across a variety of industries, delivering scalable solutions that connect creativity, technology, and business needs.


Job Summary

The System Architect serves as the ultimate design authority for enterprise-scale agency and marketing implementations. In this role, you will define and protect the architectural integrity of our Workfront ecosystem, ensuring all solution designs align with foundational governance standards, large-scale retail integration strategies, and long-term platform scalability. You will partner closely with engineering, configuration, and change control teams to deliver resilient, end-to-end solutions for a top-tier retail environment.

Responsibilities

  • Architectural Strategy & Design Authority: Lead the overall solution architecture across platforms. Review, validate, and grant final approval for agency designs to ensure compliance with enterprise foundation standards.

  • Core Ecosystem Definition: Establish architectural structures across Adobe Workfront, Workfront Fusion, in-house developed tools/platforms, and downstream enterprise integrations.
    Technical Leadership & Discovery: Facilitate technical design workshops with cross-functional stakeholders, translate complex business requirements into technical blueprints, and resolve high-impact integration challenges.

  • Governance & Impact Analysis: Own foundational impact analysis for system changes, maintain detailed change documentation, and partner with Change Control to safeguard structural integrity.

  • Implementation Oversight: Provide technical governance and guidance to configuration and QA teams throughout the rollout lifecycle.

Qualifications and Job Requirements

  • Workfront Expertise: 4+ years of hands-on experience with Adobe Workfront, including designing and architecting complex, enterprise-grade Workfront solutions.

  • Ecosystem Integration: Proven experience integrating Workfront with in-house developed tools/platforms and other enterprise systems, with a strong understanding of Workfront Fusion and the ability to support high-level integration design.

  • Governance & Scalability: Strong expertise in enterprise governance frameworks, data modeling, and designing scalable Workfront solutions for complex, high-volume environments.

  • Technical Leadership: Proven ability to exercise design authority, make critical architectural decisions, evaluate technical tradeoffs, and provide technical leadership throughout complex implementations.

  • Fluent English Level.

  • Located in Latin America.

What We Offer

  • 100% Remote Work: Enjoy the freedom to work from the location that helps you thrive. All it takes is a laptop and a reliable internet connection.

  • Highly Competitive USD Pay: Earn an excellent, market-leading compensation in USD, that goes beyond typical market offerings.

  • Paid Time Off: We value your well-being. Our paid time off policies ensure you have the chance to unwind and recharge when needed.

  • Work with Autonomy: Enjoy the freedom to manage your time as long as the work gets done. Focus on results, not the clock.

  • Work with Top American Companies: Grow your expertise working on innovative, high-impact projects with Industry-Leading U.S. Companies.

Why You’ll Like Working Here

  • A Culture That Values You: We prioritize well-being and work-life balance, offering engagement activities and fostering dynamic teams to ensure you thrive both personally and professionally.

  • Diverse, Global Network: Connect with over 600 professionals in 25+ countries, expand your network, and collaborate with a multicultural team from Latin America.

  • Team Up with Skilled Professionals: Join forces with senior talent. All of our team members are seasoned experts, ensuring you're working with the best in your field.

Apply now!

Vaga remota para atuar como System Architect em implementações de larga escala de Adobe Workfront, no modelo staff augmentation nearshore, por meio de uma consultoria sediada em Nova York, para um cliente global de tecnologia e criatividade voltado a marketing e ambientes de varejo. É uma oportunidade para trabalhar de forma 100% remota com empresas dos EUA, com pagamento em USD.

- Conduzir workshops técnicos de design com stakeholders multifuncionais, traduzindo requisitos de negócio complexos em blueprints técnicos e resolvendo desafios de integração de alto impacto.
- Ser responsável pela análise de impacto de mudanças no sistema, manter a documentação de change control e proteger a integridade estrutural da plataforma.

## Requisitos

- 4+ anos de experiência prática com Adobe Workfront, incluindo design e arquitetura de soluções complexas em nível enterprise.
- Experiência comprovada integrando Workfront com ferramentas/plataformas internas e outros sistemas corporativos, com bom domínio de Workfront Fusion.
- Sólida experiência com frameworks de governança corporativa, data modeling e design de soluções Workfront escaláveis para ambientes de alto volume.
- Capacidade comprovada de exercer design authority: tomar decisões arquiteturais críticas, avaliar tradeoffs técnicos e liderar tecnicamente implementações complexas.
- Inglês fluente.
- Residir na América Latina.

## O que oferecem

- Trabalho 100% remoto.
- Remuneração competitiva em USD, acima da média de mercado.
- Paid Time Off (férias/folgas remuneradas).
- Autonomia para gerir seu tempo, com foco em resultados.
- Projetos de alto impacto com empresas líderes dos EUA.

descriptionPtBr:
## Sobre a vaga

Candidatura aberta para Data Engineer no modelo staff augmentation nearshore, por meio de uma consultoria sediada em Nova York. Você trabalha de forma 100% remota, alocado em projetos de empresas dos EUA (de startups a Fortune 500), com pagamento em USD.

## O que você vai fazer

- Escrever código em Python para soluções de processamento de dados, usando bibliotecas como Pandas e PySpark.
- Consumir dados de diferentes fontes, como REST APIs.
- Trabalhar com data stores relacionais e não relacionais (HBase, Cassandra ou MongoDB; S3, blobs), incluindo consumo e design.
- Lidar com data streams (Kafka, Kinesis, Flume) e filas de mensagens (SQS, SNS, RabbitMQ, etc).
- Garantir que o modelo de dados escale e entregue alta performance, incluindo data stores distribuídos.
- Construir data pipelines e pipelines de ingestão e streaming escaláveis, com processamento de dados/streams (Spark, Flink, Hadoop).
- Fazer ETL com ferramentas como Talend, Informatica e SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS).
- Implementar soluções de data warehouse (Snowflake, Redshift, Hive), disponibilizando dados quase em tempo real para diversos sistemas clientes.
- Projetar e implementar aplicações e serviços de dados em nuvem pública (AWS, GCP ou Azure) usando plataformas PaaS.

## Requisitos

- 5+ anos de experiência profissional na função.
- Sólido domínio de Python aplicado a processamento de dados (Pandas, PySpark).
- Experiência com data stores relacionais e não relacionais, streams e filas de mensagens.
- Experiência com data warehouses e SQL para construção de armazenamento de dados.
- Experiência com nuvem pública (AWS, GCP ou Azure) e plataformas PaaS.
- Familiaridade com regulações de privacidade de dados e boas práticas.

## Diferenciais

- Ferramentas de BI e visualização de dados (Looker, Power BI, Tableau) — design, implementação e evolução.
- Arquiteturas de processamento de dados como Lambda Architecture.
- Indexação (Solr ou ElasticSearch).
- Experiência convertendo Jupyter Notebooks em processos de produção.
- Ferramentas de orquestração de pipelines e workflows, como Airflow.
- Data lakes.

## O que oferecem

- Trabalho 100% remoto.
- Remuneração competitiva em USD, acima da média de mercado.
- Paid Time Off (férias/folgas remuneradas).
- Autonomia para gerenciar seu tempo — foco em resultados, não em horas.
- Atuação em projetos de alto impacto com empresas líderes dos EUA, junto a um time global de 600+ profissionais em 25+ países.

  • Build working, AI-powered prototypes directly utilizing LLM APIs, platform-native features, and low-code/no-code environments to create functional solutions.

  • Utilize working demos and prototypes as the primary tool for stakeholder alignment directly within the client's actual processes.

  • Support the rollout of new tools and workflows, ensuring adoption is rooted in process design and change management.

  • Design enablement materials that ensure new technology implementations effectively connect to and support the intended operating model.

  • Support complex engagement scoping and conduct diagnostic assessments for value capture, implementation readiness, and adoption strategy.

  • Contribute reusable frameworks and tools that continuously improve practice qualification and scoping.

Qualifications and Job Requirements

  • Proven track record of building structured, evidence-based arguments to effectively influence and align senior stakeholders.

  • Hands-on experience building functional AI-powered workflows, automations, and prototypes, with the ability to ship working solutions rather than just designing them.

  • Ability to rapidly scope and build a working proof of concept within the constraints of a client engagement to move skeptical stakeholders.

  • Comfort and capability working autonomously without a dedicated engineering team, knowing exactly when to build solutions independently and when to pull in additional resources.

  • Strong diagnostic mindset with a dedication to understanding root causes and broken processes before jumping to solutions.

  • Deep accountability to actual outcomes and measurable impact rather than just static deliverables.

  • Bias toward early proof, preferring to build working prototypes over producing standard roadmaps.

  • Ability to operate effectively in a forward-deployed capacity, integrating deeply alongside client engineers, product leads, and operators.

  • Experience in large-scale organizational assessments, process redesigns, or large-scale technology rollouts is highly preferred.

This is a highly hands-on, consultative role where you will conduct organizational diagnostics and rapidly build functional, AI-powered proofs of concept to demonstrate real-world value. The ideal candidate is a proactive diagnostician and builder who blends management consulting expertise with the technical capability to ship working prototypes autonomously, ultimately accelerating business adoption and delivering measurable ROI.

 - Map current-state workflows end-to-end to diagnose root causes of operational friction, including handoff failures, governance gaps, and tooling mismatches.

 - Redesign target-state operations for leaner workflows, clearer decision rights, and effective human-agent collaboration to accelerate throughput using AI.

 - Design comprehensive operating models, including organizational structure, roles, governance, cross-functional interaction models, and value realization.

 - Establish performance baselines and build measurement frameworks that track improvement continuously throughout the engagement.

 - Identify value gaps in stalled implementations, diagnosing where technology deployment has outpaced business adoption to restore the path to ROI.

 - Build working, AI-powered prototypes directly utilizing LLM APIs, platform-native features, and low-code/no-code environments to create functional solutions.

 - Utilize working demos and prototypes as the primary tool for stakeholder alignment directly within the client's actual processes.

 - Evaluate where AI practically enhances a workflow versus where it serves as a distraction, advising clients with realistic, grounded expectations.

 - Support the rollout of new tools and workflows, ensuring adoption is rooted in process design and change management.

 - Design enablement materials that ensure new technology implementations effectively connect to and support the intended operating model.

 - Support complex engagement scoping and conduct diagnostic assessments for value capture, implementation readiness, and adoption strategy.

 - Contribute reusable frameworks and tools that continuously improve practice qualification and scoping.




QUALIFICATIONS AND JOB REQUIREMENTS

 - 5 to 10 years of experience in management consulting or equivalent roles within enterprise technology, SaaS, or professional services.

 - Demonstrated expertise in at least two of the following areas: organizational design, operating model transformation, change management, technology enablement, process engineering, or go-to-market execution.

 - Proven track record of building structured, evidence-based arguments to effectively influence and align senior stakeholders.

 - Hands-on experience building functional AI-powered workflows, automations, and prototypes, with the ability to ship working solutions rather than just designing them.

 - Ability to rapidly scope and build a working proof of concept within the constraints of a client engagement to move skeptical stakeholders.

 - Comfort and capability working autonomously without a dedicated engineering team, knowing exactly when to build solutions independently and when to pull in additional resources.

 - Strong diagnostic mindset with a dedication to understanding root causes and broken processes before jumping to solutions.

 - Deep accountability to actual outcomes and measurable impact rather than just static deliverables.

 - Bias toward early proof, preferring to build working prototypes over producing standard roadmaps.

 - Ability to operate effectively in a forward-deployed capacity, integrating deeply alongside client engineers, product leads, and operators.

 - Experience in large-scale organizational assessments, process redesigns, or large-scale technology rollouts is highly preferred.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - 100% Remote Work: Enjoy the freedom to work from the location that helps you thrive. All it takes is a laptop and a reliable internet connection.

 - Highly Competitive USD Pay: Earn an excellent, market-leading compensation in USD, that goes beyond typical market offerings.

 - Paid Time Off: We value your well-being. Our paid time off policies ensure you have the chance to unwind and recharge when needed.

 - Work with Autonomy: Enjoy the freedom to manage your time as long as the work gets done. Focus on results, not the clock.

 - Work with Top American Companies: Grow your expertise working on innovative, high-impact projects with Industry-Leading U.S. Companies.




WHY YOU’LL LIKE WORKING HERE

About the company

At the company we are a leading provider of nearshore staff augmentation services headquartered in New York. For over two decades, we’ve been delivering top-tier technology solutions to companies of all sizes, from innovative startups to industry leaders, helping them achieve their digital transformation goals.

Our team of 600+ highly skilled tech professionals, based in Latin America, drives digital disruption by partnering with U.S. companies on their most impactful projects. Whether collaborating with Fortune 500 giants or scaling startups, we deliver results that make a difference.

By applying for this position, you’re taking the first step in joining a dynamic team that values your expertise and aspirations. We aim to align your skills with opportunities that foster exceptional career growth and success while contributing to transformative projects that shape the future.

Our Client

A global digital transformation organization that helps leading enterprises reimagine how they create, manage, and deliver customer experiences by combining technology, creativity, AI, and engineering. Through multidisciplinary teams and hands-on execution, we partner with organizations to modernize workflows, scale content operations, accelerate innovation, and build solutions that drive measurable business impact.


Job Summary

We are hiring a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to work at the core of content and creative transformation engagements.

In this role, you will map existing creative workflows, redesign them, and build AI-powered pipelines that demonstrate a new operating model inside real production environments.

Building is not a differentiator in this role - it is the job. The ideal candidate comes from creative technology, production engineering, content operations, or applied AI within creative environments. You operate inside workflows, not above them.

Depending on the engagement, you may operate in a forward-deployed capacity, embedded directly within client teams and working alongside creative directors, producers, marketing technology leads, content operations teams, and engineers to redesign and ship workflows in real time.

This is not a separate program or specialization. It is an expected mode of working, requiring adaptability, hands-on execution, and close collaboration with stakeholders.

Responsibilities

Workflow Mapping & Redesign

  • Map creative workflows end-to-end, including briefing, concepting, production, review, localization, activation, and measurement.

  • Identify operational bottlenecks, inefficiencies, and opportunities for automation.

  • Diagnose root causes of workflow friction, including approval delays, handoff failures, tooling gaps, and governance challenges.

  • Design future-state workflows that effectively balance AI automation and human oversight.

AI Pipeline Development

This is the core responsibility of the role.

  • Configure and implement creative AI platforms and tools against real production requirements.

  • Integrate AI-powered workflows into existing ecosystems, including DAMs, CMS platforms, marketing technology stacks, and project management systems.

  • Build prompt architectures, agent workflows, automation layers, and quality control mechanisms that can operate reliably at production scale.

  • Develop working proofs of concept and production-ready solutions that demonstrate measurable business value.

  • Rapidly iterate and deploy solutions within the constraints of active client engagements.

Governance & Adoption

  • Establish governance frameworks covering brand safety, content rights management, model selection, approval workflows, compliance, and auditability.

  • Train and enable teams to successfully adopt new workflows and technologies.

  • Define and track success metrics, including throughput, cycle time, cost-per-asset, quality consistency, and operational efficiency.

  • Ensure knowledge transfer and long-term sustainability beyond the initial engagement.

Engagement Support & Practice Development

  • Contribute to project scoping and solution design across content operations, creative production, AI transformation, and marketing technology initiatives.

  • Develop reusable accelerators, templates, tooling configurations, and best practices.

  • Help evolve internal methodologies and delivery frameworks for future engagements.

Qualifications and Job Requirements

Experience

  • 5–10 years of experience in creative technology, content operations, production engineering, marketing technology, automation, or applied AI.

  • Demonstrated track record of shipping production-ready solutions with measurable business outcomes.

  • Experience working across both creative and technical stakeholder groups.

  • Proven ability to translate operational challenges into scalable workflow solutions.

Builder Capability (Required)

  • Hands-on experience building and deploying creative, content, or marketing workflow solutions.

  • Experience configuring and implementing creative AI tools and automation platforms in real-world environments.

  • Working knowledge of DAM systems, CMS platforms, content APIs, project management tools, and orchestration frameworks.

  • Strong understanding of LLMs, prompt engineering, AI agents, and workflow automation.

  • Ability to independently create and deploy proofs of concept that drive stakeholder alignment and adoption.

Creative Domain Expertise

  • Deep understanding of creative production processes, content supply chains, and asset lifecycle management.

  • Familiarity with enterprise creative ecosystems, including tools such as Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), Adobe Workfront, Adobe Firefly, Figma, and related platforms.

  • Ability to communicate effectively with creative directors, producers, brand operations teams, content strategists, and marketing technology stakeholders.

Mindset

  • Strong bias toward execution and delivery.

  • Diagnostic and systems-thinking approach to problem solving.

  • Comfortable operating with ambiguity and taking ownership of outcomes.

  • Able to work independently while collaborating effectively across functions.

  • Focused on practical solutions that create measurable impact.

  • Most effective working directly within operational environments rather than from a purely advisory position.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with enterprise content supply chain transformation initiatives.

  • Familiarity with creative AI platforms, agentic workflows, and automation frameworks.

  • Exposure to Adobe ecosystem products, including Firefly Services, GenStudio, AEM, and Workfront.

  • Experience embedding with client teams in consulting, agency, or enterprise transformation environments.

What We Offer

  • 100% Remote Work: Enjoy the freedom to work from the location that helps you thrive. All it takes is a laptop and a reliable internet connection.

  • Highly Competitive USD Pay: Earn an excellent, market-leading compensation in USD, that goes beyond typical market offerings.

  • Paid Time Off: We value your well-being. Our paid time off policies ensure you have the chance to unwind and recharge when needed.

  • Work with Autonomy: Enjoy the freedom to manage your time as long as the work gets done. Focus on results, not the clock.

  • Work with Top American Companies: Grow your expertise working on innovative, high-impact projects with Industry-Leading U.S. Companies.

Why You’ll Like Working Here

  • A Culture That Values You: We prioritize well-being and work-life balance, offering engagement activities and fostering dynamic teams to ensure you thrive both personally and professionally.

  • Diverse, Global Network: Connect with over 600 professionals in 25+ countries, expand your network, and collaborate with a multicultural team from Latin America.

  • Team Up with Skilled Professionals: Join forces with senior talent. All of our team members are seasoned experts, ensuring you're working with the best in your field.

Apply now!

Our client is a leading global insights and strategy firm that helps some of the world's most recognized brands make data-driven decisions at the intersection of entertainment, media, technology, gaming, sports, and culture.

With decades of industry expertise, the company combines advanced analytics, technology, and strategic consulting to deliver actionable insights that drive innovation and business growth. Their collaborative culture values curiosity, creativity, continuous learning, and technical excellence while building scalable platforms that power data products used across the organization.


Job Summary

We are looking for a DevOps Lead to help design, build, and operate the cloud infrastructure that powers the company's data and software platforms.

This role is centered around Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Infrastructure as Code with Terraform, Kubernetes, and modern CI/CD practices using GitHub Actions and Jenkins. You'll also help maintain and modernize hybrid infrastructure that includes legacy Windows Server, Oracle, and AWS environments while supporting the evolution toward a cloud-native platform.

Working closely with Data Engineering, Software Engineering, and external infrastructure partners, you'll drive reliability, security, automation, and operational excellence across development, staging, and production environments.

Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and maintain cloud infrastructure on Google Cloud Platform using Terraform and Infrastructure as Code best practices.

  • Manage Kubernetes (GKE) environments, ensuring scalability, reliability, and efficient resource utilization.

  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and Jenkins to enable reliable software delivery.

  • Monitor infrastructure health through observability, logging, alerting, and incident response improvements.

  • Collaborate with Data Engineering teams to support analytics platforms and data pipelines built on Snowflake, dbt, Dagster, and BigQuery.

  • Maintain and modernize hybrid infrastructure, including Windows Server, Oracle, SQL Server, and legacy AWS environments.

  • Improve identity and access management by implementing modern authentication solutions such as Workload Identity and OIDC.

  • Detect and resolve infrastructure drift while ensuring environments remain secure, reproducible, and cost-efficient.

  • Partner with internal engineering teams and external infrastructure providers to continuously improve platform reliability and cloud standards.

  • Mentor engineers and promote DevOps best practices, automation, and operational excellence across the organization.

Qualifications and Job Requirements

  • 6+ years of experience in DevOps, Cloud Infrastructure, Site Reliability Engineering, or Platform Engineering.

  • Strong hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) (AWS or Azure experience is also valued if willing to ramp up on GCP).

  • Advanced experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code, including state management and drift detection.

  • Production experience managing Kubernetes environments (GKE preferred).

  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or similar tools.

  • Strong understanding of cloud networking, IAM, security, and infrastructure automation.

  • Experience supporting hybrid environments combining modern cloud infrastructure with legacy Windows and database platforms.

  • Familiarity with data platforms such as Snowflake, dbt, Dagster, or BigQuery.

  • Scripting experience with Python or Bash.

  • Strong troubleshooting, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

  • Advanced English communication skills.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Oracle, SQL Server, or Windows Server administration.

  • Experience with Auth0, OIDC, or modern identity management solutions.

  • Knowledge of FinOps or cloud cost optimization practices.

  • Experience supporting large-scale analytics or data platform infrastructure.

  • Previous experience mentoring engineers or leading DevOps initiatives.

What We Offer

  • 100% Remote Work: Enjoy the freedom to work from the location that helps you thrive. All it takes is a laptop and a reliable internet connection.

  • Highly Competitive USD Pay: Earn an excellent, market-leading compensation in USD, that goes beyond typical market offerings.

  • Paid Time Off: We value your well-being. Our paid time off policies ensure you have the chance to unwind and recharge when needed.

  • Work with Autonomy: Enjoy the freedom to manage your time as long as the work gets done. Focus on results, not the clock.

  • Work with Top American Companies: Grow your expertise working on innovative, high-impact projects with Industry-Leading U.S. Companies.

Why You’ll Like Working Here

  • A Culture That Values You: We prioritize well-being and work-life balance, offering engagement activities and fostering dynamic teams to ensure you thrive both personally and professionally.

  • Diverse, Global Network: Connect with over 600 professionals in 25+ countries, expand your network, and collaborate with a multicultural team from Latin America.

  • Team Up with Skilled Professionals: Join forces with senior talent. All of our team members are seasoned experts, ensuring you're working with the best in your field.

Job Summary

The Semi-Senior DevOps Engineer will play a key role in designing, implementing, and maintaining scalable, secure, and highly available cloud infrastructure on AWS. This position focuses on Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD automation, platform reliability, observability, and operational excellence while supporting the continuous evolution of a modern SaaS platform. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with AWS services, infrastructure automation, serverless architectures, and monitoring solutions, and enjoys collaborating with cross-functional engineering, product, security, and SRE teams to improve platform scalability, reliability, and developer productivity.

Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and maintain scalable, secure, and highly available AWS infrastructure.

  • Develop and manage Infrastructure as Code using Terraform and CloudFormation.

  • Build, optimize, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using modern automation tools.

  • Monitor production environments using observability platforms such as Prometheus, Grafana, and Datadog.

  • Troubleshoot production incidents and perform root cause analysis.

  • Improve automation, deployment, and operational processes to increase platform efficiency.

  • Collaborate with Engineering, Product, Security, and SRE teams to deliver reliable cloud solutions.

  • Support serverless applications and cloud-native architectures.

  • Contribute to platform scalability, reliability, performance, and cost optimization initiatives.

  • Follow cloud security best practices, including IAM, secrets management, and encryption.

Qualifications and Job Requirements

  • 2–4 years of experience in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, or a related role.

- Experiência comprovada em analisar, modificar e migrar com segurança sistemas de produção grandes e complexos, com cobertura de testes limitada e documentação incompleta (experiência direta com legado é um grande diferencial, mas experiência equivalente em migração de sistemas complexos também é aceita).

About the company

At the company we are a leading provider of nearshore staff augmentation services headquartered in New York. For over two decades, we’ve been delivering top-tier technology solutions to companies of all sizes, from innovative startups to industry leaders, helping them achieve their digital transformation goals.

Our Client

Our client is an award-winning, leading strategic digital communications and transformation agency operating at the intersection of enterprise-grade technology and creative delivery. As a critical hub within a premier global digital services and marketing network, they collaborate directly with major regional brands, government entities, and large-scale destination enterprises to architect high-impact digital experiences. They specialize in driving large-scale digital transformation across the hospitality, tourism, travel, and commerce sectors.


Job Summary

The Senior Manager, Product Catalog & PIM is a highly strategic business owner and subject matter expert responsible for establishing, governing, and optimizing the enterprise product catalog strategy. This role leads the end-to-end evaluation, design, onboarding, and implementation of a centralized Product Information Management (PIM) ecosystem—specifically utilizing tools like Akeneo—and unifies it with Adobe Experience Manager (AEM). This position sits at the center of cross-functional alignment, ensuring scalable, consistent, and localized (+8 languages) multi-product data models power everything from mobile apps and booking funnels to complex resort channel systems.

Responsibilities

  • Catalog Strategy & Governance: Define the master enterprise catalog vision, operating model, taxonomy structures, data ownership rules, and lifecycle management workflows across distinct product business lines.

  • PIM Platform Leadership: Act as the primary Product Owner and business lead for the end-to-end evaluation, deployment, and rollout of the enterprise PIM ecosystem.

  • Complex Data Modeling: Architect omnichannel-ready product schemas that map complex variations, hierarchies, and cross-sell structures across accommodations, activities, memberships, mobility, and retail offerings.

  • Enterprise Systems Integration: Drive the integration strategy connecting the PIM with Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), resort channel managers, inventory engines, payment platforms, and CRM solutions.

  • Booking & Conversion Enablement: Optimize product discoverability and merchant capabilities by configuring rich metadata, media, and promotional bundles that drive personalization and recommendation engines.

  • Data Quality & Localization: Set corporate data validation benchmarks, track catalog health metrics, and manage multilingual localization layers (+8 languages).

  • Stakeholder Management: Facilitate alignment workshops and coordinate directly between Revenue Management, Commerce, Digital Experience, and external implementation partners.

Qualifications and Job Requirements

  • Must-Have Technical Expectations & Core Skills:

    • Educational Background: Bachelor's degree in Information Management, Business, Digital Commerce, Information Systems, Hospitality, or a related field.

    • Experience: 10+ years of dedicated professional experience in Product Information Management (PIM), Product Catalog Management, Digital Commerce, or Master Data Management (MDM).

    • Niche Domain Expertise: Proven experience leading enterprise PIM implementations specifically within the hospitality, travel, resorts, e-commerce, marketplaces, or booking ecosystems.

    • Core PIM Tools: Strong technical strategy background with PIM setups (with a targeted preference for Akeneo, or leading platforms like Salsify, Informatica, Pimcore, Stibo Systems, or inriver).

    • Ecosystem Familiarity: Direct experience working alongside Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) and Adobe Experience Cloud platforms.

    • Architecture Literacy: Thorough understanding of API-driven integrations, data validation schemas, Master Data Management (MDM) concepts, and data governance frameworks.

    Nice-to-Have:

    • CRM Systems: Familiarity with enterprise CRM tools such as Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics, or Adobe Campaign.

    • Asset & Analytics Tools: Experience interacting with Digital Asset Management (DAM) platforms and modern product analytics software (GA4, Adobe Analytics, Power BI, or Tableau).

    • Certifications: Professional credentials in PIM platforms, data governance frameworks, Salesforce, or Adobe Experience Cloud.

    Engagement & Timezone Details:

    • Location: 100% Remote (LatAm).

    • Timezone Alignment: Flexibility is required to align seamlessly with Middle East working hours (Gulf Standard Time - GST / Eastern European Time - EET scales) to collaborate directly with teams across Dubai, Saudi Arabia, and Egypt.

What We Offer

  • 100% Remote Work: Enjoy the freedom to work from the location that helps you thrive. All it takes is a laptop and a reliable internet connection.

  • Highly Competitive USD Pay: Earn an excellent, market-leading compensation in USD, that goes beyond typical market offerings.

  • Paid Time Off: We value your well-being. Our paid time off policies ensure you have the chance to unwind and recharge when needed.

  • Work with Autonomy: Enjoy the freedom to manage your time as long as the work gets done. Focus on results, not the clock.

  • Work with Top American Companies: Grow your expertise working on innovative, high-impact projects with Industry-Leading U.S. Companies.

Why You’ll Like Working Here

  • A Culture That Values You: We prioritize well-being and work-life balance, offering engagement activities and fostering dynamic teams to ensure you thrive both personally and professionally.

  • Diverse, Global Network: Connect with over 600 professionals in 25+ countries, expand your network, and collaborate with a multicultural team from Latin America.

About the company

At the company we are a leading provider of nearshore staff augmentation services headquartered in New York. Our Client

A leading innovator in the veterinary technology space, providing a comprehensive ecosystem of practice management software, AI tools, and clinical decision support used by professionals worldwide.


Job Summary

As a Senior Data Engineer, you will take end-to-end ownership of a rapidly scaling data platform, driving the ingestion, transformation, storage, and delivery of critical analytics for veterinary clinics. Working within a high-ownership, fully remote engineering team, you will ensure the health and reliability of complex pipelines, leverage modern infrastructure-as-code practices, and establish robust data quality standards. The ideal candidate is a battle-tested builder who has previously constructed data platforms from the ground up, seamlessly combining deep data warehousing expertise with hands-on infrastructure management.

Responsibilities

  • Take end-to-end ownership of the data platform's reliability, encompassing pipelines, warehousing, transformations, and observability.

  • Design, build, and maintain robust data pipelines using Apache Airflow, orchestrating complex workflows across batch and near-real-time workloads.

  • Manage and optimize the primary Snowflake data warehouse, handling schema design, clustering keys, materialized views, access controls, and strict cost governance.

  • Build and maintain the dbt transformation layer, including model design, incremental strategies, dependency management, and documentation.

  • Deploy and operate data platform services on Kubernetes (EKS), independently managing workloads, debugging pod issues, and tuning resource requests.

  • Provision and manage data platform infrastructure, including Snowflake resources and Airflow, utilizing Terraform.

  • Write high-quality SQL and Python for ETL tooling, pipeline logic, and data product delivery.

  • Manage PostgreSQL as a source-of-truth operational database, focusing on query optimization, indexing, replication, and migrations.

  • Lead the transition toward change data capture (CDC) for data ingestion, utilizing tools like Debezium to stream database changes.

  • Implement comprehensive observability, SLA tracking, and alerting across the data platform using Datadog.

  • Maintain CI/CD pipelines for DAG deployments, dbt runs, schema migrations, and container image builds.

  • Collaborate with analytics, product, and full-stack development teams to model clean, well-documented data products.

  • Navigate AWS environments (including RDS and S3) to manage data-adjacent services, read logs, and adjust scaling parameters.

Qualifications and Job Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in data engineering or a combined data and infrastructure role, with a proven track record of building production-grade data platforms from the ground up.

  • Deep expertise in Snowflake, including schema design, performance tuning, access control, and advanced cost optimization.

  • Strong, hands-on experience with dbt (modeling patterns, incremental strategies, testing) and Airflow (writing DAGs, managing dependencies, debugging).

  • Advanced proficiency in SQL and solid programming skills in Python for ETL and automation.

  • Working knowledge of Kubernetes, with the ability to deploy workloads, read pod logs, and manage Helm charts independently.

  • Extensive experience using Terraform for infrastructure provisioning, specifically for managing data platform components.

  • Hands-on experience with Datadog for observability, monitoring, and SLA visibility.

  • Familiarity with AWS data-adjacent services like RDS and S3.

  • Fluency in utilizing AI-based development assistants to write, review, and debug code efficiently.

  • Prior experience with Amazon Redshift is a plus.

  • Familiarity with streaming infrastructure (Kafka, Flink) or open table formats (Iceberg, Delta Lake) is highly preferred.

  • Experience with Elixir or Erlang is advantageous.

  • Knowledge of data quality, cataloging, or lineage tooling (e.g., Great Expectations, Soda, Monte Carlo, DataHub, OpenMetadata) is a strong plus.

  • Hands-on experience with Debezium or comparable CDC tooling, particularly in production deployments, is a strong bonus.

  • Experience managing EKS Spot instances at scale is a plus.

  • Background in healthcare, veterinary medicine, or similarly regulated domains requiring strict data accuracy and auditability is preferred.

What We Offer

  • 100% Remote Work: Enjoy the freedom to work from the location that helps you thrive. All it takes is a laptop and a reliable internet connection.

  • Highly Competitive USD Pay: Earn an excellent, market-leading compensation in USD, that goes beyond typical market offerings.

  • Paid Time Off: We value your well-being. Our paid time off policies ensure you have the chance to unwind and recharge when needed.

  • Work with Autonomy: Enjoy the freedom to manage your time as long as the work gets done. Focus on results, not the clock.

  • Work with Top American Companies: Grow your expertise working on innovative, high-impact projects with Industry-Leading U.S. Companies.

Why You’ll Like Working Here

Você será dono, de ponta a ponta, de uma plataforma de dados em rápido crescimento.

## O que você vai fazer

- Assumir a responsabilidade completa pela confiabilidade da plataforma de dados: pipelines, data warehousing, transformações e observabilidade.
- Projetar e manter pipelines de dados robustos com Apache Airflow, orquestrando workflows em batch e near-real-time.
- Gerenciar e otimizar o data warehouse principal em Snowflake (design de schema, clustering keys, materialized views, controle de acesso e governança de custos).
- Construir e manter a camada de transformação em dbt (modelagem, estratégias incrementais, gestão de dependências e documentação).
- Fazer deploy e operar serviços da plataforma em Kubernetes (EKS), debugando pods e ajustando recursos.
- Provisionar e gerenciar a infraestrutura da plataforma (recursos de Snowflake e Airflow) usando Terraform.
- Escrever SQL e Python de alta qualidade para ETL, lógica de pipelines e entrega de data products.
- Gerenciar PostgreSQL como banco operacional de source-of-truth (otimização de queries, indexação, replicação e migrations).
- Liderar a transição para change data capture (CDC) na ingestão de dados, com ferramentas como Debezium.
- Implementar observabilidade, tracking de SLA e alertas com Datadog.
- Manter pipelines de CI/CD para deploy de DAGs, execuções de dbt, migrations de schema e builds de imagens.
- Colaborar com times de analytics, produto e full-stack para modelar data products limpos e bem documentados.
- Operar ambientes AWS (incluindo RDS e S3) para gerenciar serviços, ler logs e ajustar escalonamento.

## Requisitos

- 5+ anos em data engineering ou em função combinada de dados e infraestrutura, com histórico comprovado de construir plataformas de dados de produção do zero.
- Domínio profundo de Snowflake (design de schema, tuning de performance, controle de acesso e otimização avançada de custos).
- Experiência prática forte com dbt (padrões de modelagem, estratégias incrementais, testes) e Airflow (escrever DAGs, gerenciar dependências, debug).
- Proficiência avançada em SQL e boa base de programação em Python para ETL e automação.
- Conhecimento prático de Kubernetes (deploy de workloads, leitura de logs de pods, gestão de Helm charts de forma autônoma).
- Experiência sólida com Terraform para provisionamento de infraestrutura, especialmente de componentes de plataforma de dados.
- Experiência prática com Datadog para observabilidade, monitoramento e visibilidade de SLA.
- Familiaridade com serviços AWS ligados a dados, como RDS e S3.
- Fluência no uso de assistentes de desenvolvimento baseados em IA para escrever, revisar e debugar código.

## Diferenciais

- Experiência com Amazon Redshift.
- Familiaridade com infraestrutura de streaming (Kafka, Flink) ou open table formats (Iceberg, Delta Lake) — altamente valorizado.
- Experiência com Elixir ou Erlang.
- Conhecimento de ferramentas de data quality, cataloging ou lineage (Great Expectations, Soda, Monte Carlo, DataHub, OpenMetadata).
- Experiência prática com Debezium ou CDC equivalente, especialmente em produção.
- Experiência gerenciando EKS Spot instances em escala.
- Vivência em saúde, medicina veterinária ou domínios regulados que exigem rigor de precisão e auditabilidade de dados.

## O que oferecem

- Trabalho 100% remoto.
- Pagamento em USD, com remuneração competitiva acima da média de mercado.
- Paid Time Off (PTO).
- Autonomia para gerir seu tempo, com foco em resultados.
- Projetos de alto impacto com empresas americanas líderes de mercado.

descriptionHtml:
About the company

At the company we are a leading provider of nearshore staff augmentation services headquartered in New York. For over two decades, we’ve been delivering top-tier technology solutions to companies of all sizes, from innovative startups to industry leaders, helping them achieve their digital transformation goals.

Our team of 600+ highly skilled tech professionals, based in Latin America, drives digital disruption by partnering with U.S. companies on their most impactful projects. Whether collaborating with Fortune 500 giants or scaling startups, we deliver results that make a difference.

By applying for this position, you’re taking the first step in joining a dynamic team that values your expertise and aspirations. We aim to align your skills with opportunities that foster exceptional career growth and success while contributing to transformative projects that shape the future.

Our Client

This company is far more than a traditional real estate brokerage — it is a tech-powered media company reinventing how real estate is bought, sold, and experienced, combining elite sales talent, cutting-edge technology, and world-class content creation to build a completely new industry approach; its ecosystem spans luxury residential real estate, a powerful education platform, and an in-house creative agency, forming a vertically integrated model that is reshaping the real estate landscape, while offering engineers the opportunity to join an organization that treats technology as a core strategic differentiator, empowers small, autonomous, high-impact teams with full ownership, and values great design, clean code, and exceptional user experience, all within a company that is actively building the future of real estate.


Job Summary

We are looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to join a high-impact engineering team building scalable, reliable, and data-intensive systems.

This is a hands-on role for an engineer who thinks beyond individual features and understands systems, data integrity, distributed architectures, and reliability. You will own features end-to-end—from PostgreSQL schema design and backend services to React/Next.js interfaces and production observability.

The ideal candidate has strong experience with TypeScript, Node.js, React/Next.js, PostgreSQL, and event-driven systems, along with a proven ability to design reliable workflows around asynchronous processing, webhooks, third-party integrations, and high-stakes transactional data.

Responsibilities

  • Own features end-to-end, including database schema design, backend APIs, frontend development, testing, deployment, and production monitoring.

  • Design and build event-driven and distributed systems that remain reliable in the face of failures, retries, duplicate events, and asynchronous processing.

  • Design and optimize PostgreSQL solutions, including complex SQL queries, migrations, indexes, transactions, and query performance using tools such as EXPLAIN ANALYZE.

  • Build reliable integrations with third-party systems using webhooks, queues, retries, idempotency, and reconciliation processes.

  • Implement reliability patterns such as idempotency keys, dead-letter queues (DLQs), transactional outbox patterns, and reconciliation loops.

  • Build polished, responsive user experiences using React and Next.js.

  • Identify architectural and performance bottlenecks and proactively improve scalability, reliability, and data consistency.

  • Use AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code or similar agentic coding tools for complex development, debugging, testing, and architectural tasks.

  • Contribute to code reviews, technical decisions, internal tooling, and engineering standards.

  • Mentor other engineers and promote best practices for handling sensitive and transactional data.

  • Partner with Product, Design, and Engineering teams to translate business requirements into reliable technical solutions.

Qualifications and Job Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional Full-Stack Engineering experience building and shipping production applications end-to-end.

  • Strong hands-on experience with TypeScript and Node.js.

  • Advanced experience with React and Next.js.

  • Deep PostgreSQL/database engineering experience.

  • Proven experience designing and operating event-driven and distributed systems.

  • Strong understanding of reliability patterns

  • Hands-on experience building webhook-driven integrations and working with asynchronous workflows.

  • Experience working with financial or high-stakes transactional systems, such as fintech, payments, billing, payroll, or ledgering.

  • Demonstrated experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code or equivalent agentic coding platforms for meaningful engineering tasks.

  • Strong systems-thinking mindset with a focus on data integrity, edge cases, failure scenarios, and operational reliability.

Nice to have

  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code, particularly Terraform or Pulumi.

  • Experience with observability and distributed tracing, including Datadog or OpenTelemetry.

  • Experience working in regulated or compliance-heavy environments, such as SOC 2 or PCI-DSS.

- 5+ anos de experiência em UX Design ou UX/UI Design.
- Domínio de Figma.
- Experiência comprovada com clientes enterprise dos EUA ou globais, projetando experiências digitais em organizações grandes e complexas.
- Experiência desenhando aplicações web responsivas.
- Prática em pesquisa com usuários e usability testing.
- Sólido entendimento de arquitetura de informação, interaction design e princípios de user-centered design.
- Experiência criando wireframes, user flows, journey maps e protótipos interativos.
- Capacidade de produzir documentação de UX clara.
- Boa capacidade analítica e de resolução de problemas.
- Excelente comunicação e apresentação, e colaboração com times multidisciplinares.
- Portfólio online forte, com case studies de UX e processo de design.
- Inglês avançado (C1–C2) obrigatório.

- FigJam e Miro.
- Adobe Creative Suite.
- UserTesting, Optimal Workshop ou PlaybookUX.
- Metodologias de A/B testing.
- Ferramentas de web analytics.
- Noções básicas de HTML, CSS e JavaScript.
- Boas práticas de acessibilidade (WCAG).

descriptionHtml:
About the company

At the company we are a leading provider of nearshore staff augmentation services headquartered in New York. For over two decades, we’ve been delivering top-tier technology solutions to companies of all sizes, from innovative startups to industry leaders, helping them achieve their digital transformation goals.

By applying for this position, you’re taking the first step in joining a dynamic team that values your expertise and aspirations. We aim to align your skills with opportunities that foster exceptional career growth and success while contributing to transformative projects that shape the future.

Our Client

We are a veterinary software company that helps practices enhance patient care, improve staff efficiency, and minimize burnout. We were founded in 2017 and are a mid-size company (50-100 people) that has used Elixir from the start. Our back-end runs fully in Elixir with our front-end in React, with GraphQL connecting the two.


Job Summary

The Support Engineer is a dedicated technical bridge between the Platform Engineering organization and the Customer Experience (CX) team. In this role, you will own the technical execution of customer onboarding/decommissioning workflows, execute complex SQL data migrations, and resolve platform-level technical escalations.

While you sit directly within the Platform Engineering team, you will work in close partnership with Customer Success and Implementation Managers to translate customer and operational needs into reliable technical solutions. This is an ideal role for an autonomous problem-solver who enjoys operating at the intersection of cloud infrastructure, data operations, and customer-facing support.

Responsibilities

  • Customer Onboarding: Execute technical onboarding workflows for new Instinct customers, including environment provisioning, configuration, integration setup, and data imports to ensure a seamless go-live experience.

  • Decommissioning: Manage the technical offboarding of customers, including data exports, environment teardown, access revocation, and formal documentation of closure procedures.

  • Data Migrations: Perform structured data migrations between systems or environments—handling validation, transformation, and quality assurance checks to ensure absolute data integrity. Occasionally join live customer calls to address data validation questions directly with key stakeholders.

  • Technical Ticket Resolution: Own and lead the queue of technical tickets escalated by the CX team; triage, prioritize, and resolve complex issues outside CX's scope, including environment configuration, integration troubleshooting, bulk data updates, and platform-level issues.

  • CX Partnership: Partner closely with Customer Success Managers and Implementation Managers to understand the context behind incoming requests, set clear resolution timelines, and communicate technical outcomes in accessible, plain language.

  • Documentation: Maintain clear, up-to-date documentation of processes, runbooks, and customer-specific configurations to drive repeatability and preserve institutional knowledge.

  • Process Improvement: Analyze patterns in recurring CX-submitted tickets to proactively develop tooling, automation, or updated documentation—reducing overall ticket volume and resolution times.

  • Adaptability: Adapt to and actively contribute to new tasks, priorities, or projects as organizational needs evolve.

Qualifications and Job Requirements

Must-Have (Required):

  • AWS: Hands-on ability to verify environment changes and execute smoke tests; practical familiarity with core services (e.g., RDS, S3, EC2, ECS) to independently validate that workflows have completed successfully.

  • Git / GitHub: Proficient in creating, reviewing, merging, and verifying pull requests within GitHub as an integral part of standard customer onboarding and offboarding workflows.

  • Communication: Exceptional written and verbal English communication skills; capable of leading customer calls with confidence, translating complex technical concepts into plain language for non-technical stakeholders, and drafting high-quality documentation.

  • Basic Security Hygiene: Solid foundational understanding of data privacy best practices, the principle of least-privilege access, and secure data handling protocols.

  • Ticketing Systems: Hands-on experience navigating support and helpdesk platforms such as Jira, Intercom, Front, or equivalent ticketing systems.

Nice-to-Have (A Plus):

  • Terraform: Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) principles to review, update, or provision infrastructure configurations.

  • Kubernetes: Basic understanding of container orchestration, pod management, and inspecting workloads within Kubernetes clusters.

  • Helm: Experience using Helm charts to deploy, upgrade, and manage Kubernetes applications and services.

What We Offer

  • 100% Remote Work: Enjoy the freedom to work from the location that helps you thrive. All it takes is a laptop and a reliable internet connection.

  • Highly Competitive USD Pay: Earn an excellent, market-leading compensation in USD, that goes beyond typical market offerings.

  • Paid Time Off: We value your well-being. Our paid time off policies ensure you have the chance to unwind and recharge when needed.

  • Work with Autonomy: Enjoy the freedom to manage your time as long as the work gets done. Focus on results, not the clock.

  • Work with Top American Companies: Grow your expertise working on innovative, high-impact projects with Industry-Leading U.S. Companies.

Why You’ll Like Working Here

  • A Culture That Values You: We prioritize well-being and work-life balance, offering engagement activities and fostering dynamic teams to ensure you thrive both personally and professionally.

  • Diverse, Global Network: Connect with over 600 professionals in 25+ countries, expand your network, and collaborate with a multicultural team from Latin America.

  • Team Up with Skilled Professionals: Join forces with senior talent. All of our team members are seasoned experts, ensuring you're working with the best in your field.

Apply now!

## Sobre a vaga

Vaga remota para atuar com uma empresa dos EUA (modelo nearshore, staff augmentation) como Support Engineer em uma healthtech veterinária de médio porte, cujo software ajuda clínicas a melhorar o atendimento e a eficiência das equipes. A stack do cliente roda em Elixir no back-end e React no front-end, conectados por GraphQL.

Você será a ponte técnica entre o time de Platform Engineering e o time de Customer Experience (CX): cuidando de onboarding e offboarding técnico de clientes, migrações de dados via SQL e resolução de escalações técnicas da plataforma.

## O que você vai fazer

- **Onboarding de clientes**: executar os fluxos técnicos de entrada de novos clientes, incluindo provisionamento de ambiente, configuração, setup de integrações e importação de dados para um go-live tranquilo.
- **Decommissioning**: gerenciar a saída técnica de clientes, com exportação de dados, desmontagem do ambiente, revogação de acessos e documentação formal do encerramento.
- **Migrações de dados**: realizar migrações estruturadas entre sistemas ou ambientes, cuidando de validação, transformação e QA para garantir a integridade dos dados. Eventualmente, participar de calls com clientes para tratar dúvidas de validação diretamente com os stakeholders.
- **Resolução de tickets técnicos**: assumir a fila de tickets escalados pelo CX, fazendo triagem, priorização e resolução de problemas complexos (configuração de ambiente, troubleshooting de integrações, atualizações em massa e questões de plataforma).
- **Parceria com o CX**: trabalhar de perto com Customer Success e Implementation Managers para entender o contexto das demandas, definir prazos claros e comunicar resultados técnicos em linguagem acessível.
- **Documentação**: manter processos, runbooks e configurações específicas de clientes sempre atualizados.
- **Melhoria de processos**: identificar padrões em tickets recorrentes e desenvolver ferramentas, automações ou documentação que reduzam o volume e o tempo de resolução.

## Requisitos

- **AWS**: capacidade prática de verificar mudanças de ambiente e rodar smoke tests; familiaridade com serviços centrais (RDS, S3, EC2, ECS) para validar que os fluxos foram concluídos.
- **Git / GitHub**: domínio na criação, revisão, merge e verificação de pull requests como parte dos fluxos de onboarding e offboarding.
- **Inglês**: comunicação escrita e verbal excelente; capaz de conduzir calls com clientes, traduzir conceitos técnicos para stakeholders não técnicos e produzir documentação de qualidade.
- **Segurança básica**: bom entendimento de boas práticas de privacidade de dados, princípio de menor privilégio e manuseio seguro de dados.
- **Sistemas de ticketing**: experiência com plataformas de suporte/helpdesk como Jira, Intercom, Front ou equivalentes.

## Diferenciais

- **Terraform**: familiaridade com Infrastructure as Code (IaC) para revisar, atualizar ou provisionar configurações de infraestrutura.
- **Kubernetes**: noções de orquestração de containers, gestão de pods e inspeção de workloads em clusters.
- **Helm**: experiência com Helm charts para deploy, upgrade e gestão de aplicações no Kubernetes.

## O que oferecem

- **100% remoto**: trabalhe de onde preferir, bastando um laptop e uma boa conexão.
- **Pagamento em USD**: remuneração competitiva, acima da média de mercado.
- **PTO (férias/folgas remuneradas)** e autonomia para gerir o próprio tempo, com foco em resultados.
- Oportunidade de trabalhar em projetos de alto impacto com empresas líderes dos EUA.
